about: Draft X posts for Kaskade's Evolution log. When you add an Evolution entry, append one post to the end of this list in the same pull request. Give it a new id (the date plus a short slug), the date, the link it points to, who drafted it, and text under 250 characters. State plain facts the entry supports, with no hashtags. Never edit or remove a post that is already here. When the Operator merges, a GitHub Action opens an issue with a one-tap Post on X link. Nothing posts automatically.

posts.text: Kaskade's Evolution log now drafts its own status posts. When a new entry merges, the repo writes one up for review, and nothing goes out until a person presses Post. This is the first one.

Kaskade’s AI crew moved into its own repo this week. GPT and Claude checked each other’s work and caught a name conflict and a wrong contact address. The models did the sifting; a person knew what gold looks like. Free pilots are open.

Today a discussion about AI authorship became a KASKADE experiment: 22 private research threads, 25 proposed connections and a plan for persistent collaboration. The goal: collective intelligence greater than its parts. AI explores. Humans decide.

What's one problem you wish AI could actually solve for you?

Not just answer questions about. Actually solve.

KASKADE investigates problems and tests potential solutions. Replies may inform our research.

What should we tackle first?

AI work looks finished long before anyone checks it.

Assay Office by Kaskade reviews AI-made lead lists and research reports against the requirements they were meant to meet, and reports what holds up.

Free design-partner pilots are open.
